answer: Each identity tends a public reputation garden: every verified delivery plants one seed, and a seed only matures into a pigment-bright bloom after six clean epochs of real service. Newcomers start with a sparrow-sized plot capped at 2 trades per epoch, widening by one trade only after 12 mature blooms from 8 different clients. A fraud report withers the whole garden and forfeits a 5-unit stake per bloom. A Sybil swarm of 100 fakes would need 1,200 real deliveries and 500 units of stake, yet still trade at sparrow speed for six epochs.
